findings.issue_category: missing key rotation and overly permissive default policy
findings.description: The KMS key does not set enable_key_rotation, leaving automatic annual key rotation disabled (default is false), which weakens cryptographic hygiene for a key protecting audit trail data. Additionally, no policy attribute is specified, so AWS applies the default key policy granting full access (kms:*) to the root account and, by extension, any IAM principal with sufficient IAM permissions, which is broader than least privilege for a sensitive audit-logging key.
